entries.title: Leaving nothing unfinished
entries.literal_meaning: A remnant of debt, a remnant of illness—never leave a trace of either.
entries.explanation: The paired remnants give the instruction its insistence: a problem left over still demands attention. This is the saying’s absolute rhetoric, not a promise that illness or debt can always be eliminated. Our transfer to unfinished paperwork draws on that insistence without turning the line into medical or financial advice.
entries.meaning_odia: ଋଣ ଓ ରୋଗର ଅବଶେଷକୁ ଯୋଡ଼ି କଥାଟି ଜୋର ଦେଉଛି—ରହିଯାଇଥିବା ସମସ୍ୟା ପୁଣି ଧ୍ୟାନ ମାଗେ। ଏହା କଥାର ନିରଙ୍କୁଶ ଆଦେଶ, ସବୁ ରୋଗ ବା ଋଣ ନିଶ୍ଚୟ ଦୂର ହେବାର ପ୍ରତିଶ୍ରୁତି ନୁହେଁ। ଅଧାରହିଥିବା କାଗଜକାମରେ ଆମ ପ୍ରୟୋଗ ସେହି ଜୋରକୁ ନେଉଛି; ଚିକିତ୍ସା ବା ଆର୍ଥିକ ପରାମର୍ଶ ଦେଉନାହିଁ।
entries.english_summary: The paired remnants press for completion; our everyday application is editorial.
entries.odia_summary: ଦୁଇ ଅବଶେଷର ଚିତ୍ର କାମ ସାରିବାର ଜୋର ଆଣେ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: A club secretary has filed a report but left its final attachment loose. A colleague quotes the line, then says, “For this report, let us attach the missing page before putting it away.” The scene concerns paperwork, not treatment or repayment decisions.
entries.cultural_context: The headword means complete cure. The verse gives an absolute exhortation; it does not establish causes of illness or blame people with continuing difficulties.

entries.title: Start again for the headman
entries.literal_meaning: When the headman arrives, sing from the beginning.
entries.explanation: In our reading, a late arrival changes where the song must begin. Placed under “village headman,” the line brings authority into that restart. Our reading hears a teasing complaint: everyone else has already listened, but the important newcomer gets the beginning again. The dictionary supplies the role, not a documented performance custom or this modern meeting application.
entries.meaning_odia: ଆସିଥିବା ଲୋକଟି ପାଇଁ ଗୀତ ପୁଣି ମୂଳରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୁଏ। ଅଭିଧାନର ଗ୍ରାମପ୍ରଧାନ ଅର୍ଥ ଏହି ପୁନରାରମ୍ଭରେ ପଦମର୍ଯ୍ୟାଦାକୁ ଆଣେ। ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ ଟିକେ ଟାହି ଅଛି—ଅନ୍ୟମାନେ ଶୁଣିସାରିଲେଣି, ତଥାପି ବଡ଼ଲୋକଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ପୁଣି ଆରମ୍ଭ! ଅଭିଧାନ ଭୂମିକାଟି ବୁଝାଏ; କୌଣସି ପ୍ରମାଣିତ ଗାୟନପ୍ରଥା ବା ଆଜିର ସଭାର ଉଦାହରଣ ଦିଏନାହିଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading hears a teasing restart for someone with authority.
entries.odia_summary: ପଦମର୍ଯ୍ୟାଦା ପାଇଁ ପୁଣି ଆରମ୍ଭ କରିବାର ଟାହି।

entries.cultural_context: The quotation belongs to the village-headman sense, separately from the headword’s family-title and military senses. It identifies no present caste, family or officeholder.

entries.title: Trouble where I sought refuge
entries.literal_meaning: I fled into my aunt’s house; my aunt struck me at a bad time.
entries.explanation: The first-person speaker runs towards a relative and meets another blow. Our reading follows that reversal: the hoped-for refuge adds to the trouble. The quotation follows the headword’s “bad time” sense; its other senses are noon and midnight, so a precise clock time is not established here. The line gives one sharp scene, not a verdict on aunts.
entries.meaning_odia: କଥକ ପଳାଇ ସମ୍ପର୍କୀୟଙ୍କ ଘରେ ପଶିଲେ, ସେଠି ପୁଣି ମାଡ଼ ଖାଇଲେ। ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ ଆଶ୍ରୟର ଆଶା ଓ ନୂଆ ବିପଦର ଓଲଟା ଚିତ୍ର ଅଛି। ଉଦ୍ଧୃତିଟି ଅଭିଧାନର ଅସମୟ ଅର୍ଥ ପରେ ଆସିଛି; ଅନ୍ୟ ଅର୍ଥ ମଧ୍ୟାହ୍ନ ଓ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧରାତ୍ର। ତେଣୁ ଏଠି ଘଣ୍ଟାର ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ସମୟ ଧରାଯାଇନାହିଁ। ଗୋଟିଏ ତୀକ୍ଷ୍ଣ ଘଟଣା ସବୁ ମାଉସୀଙ୍କ ବିଚାର ନୁହେଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading follows refuge turning into further trouble.
entries.odia_summary: ଆଶ୍ରୟ ଖୋଜି ଆଉ ଦୁଃଖ ପାଇବାର ଓଲଟା ଚିତ୍ର।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: After a difficult committee meeting, someone asks a friend for help drafting a reply. The friend begins another scolding. “ପଳେଇ ପଶିଲି ମାଉସୀ ଘରେ…” the visitor says ruefully. Here the added blow is criticism; that nonliteral setting is our invention.
entries.cultural_context: The dictionary’s placement guides this translation without erasing its multiple time senses. The example transfers physical violence into verbal disappointment; it does not approve either.

entries.title: Resolve and a neighbourhood’s stigma
entries.literal_meaning: If the mind is firm, then a home even in the sex workers’ quarter.
entries.explanation: The contrast makes firmness of mind stand against a stigmatized address. The source defines the quarter but gives no account of its residents’ conduct. Our critical reading separates personal resolve from that inherited suspicion: where someone lives cannot establish their worth. This challenge to the stigma is our response, not a counter-moral supplied by the saying.
entries.meaning_odia: ମନର ଦୃଢ଼ତା ସାମ୍ନାରେ ଏଠି ଏକ କଳଙ୍କିତ କରାଯାଇଥିବା ଠିକଣା ରଖାଯାଇଛି। ଉତ୍ସ ସାହିର ଅର୍ଥ ଦିଏ, ବାସିନ୍ଦାଙ୍କ ଆଚରଣର ବିବରଣୀ ନୁହେଁ। ଆମ ସମାଲୋଚନାତ୍ମକ ପଢ଼ା ମନର ଦୃଢ଼ତାକୁ ସେହି ସନ୍ଦେହଠାରୁ ଅଲଗା କରେ: ଠିକଣାରୁ ମଣିଷର ମୂଲ୍ୟ ଜଣାଯାଏନାହିଁ। କଳଙ୍କକୁ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ କରିବା ଆମର ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା, କଥାଟି ଦେଇଥିବା ଓଲଟା ନୀତି ନୁହେଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our critical reading distinguishes resolve from prejudice about an address.
entries.odia_summary: ମନର ଦୃଢ଼ତାକୁ ଠିକଣାର ପୂର୍ବଧାରଣାଠାରୁ ଅଲଗା କରିବା।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: In a reading group, a participant quotes the line as praise of resolve. Another asks why the neighbourhood must carry suspicion in the first place. They discuss the contrast without judging its residents. This is an invented critical conversation, not collected traditional usage.
entries.cultural_context: Historical derogatory naming remains in the exact witness. No named neighbourhood, universal community trait, documented incident or contemporary sex-work condition is inferred.
